name: Ja - Monstr?
source:
You have become a werewolf! But that beastly appearance is not as dangerous as the beast growing inside you. Are you a monster or a human? That is the answer you need to discover.
	
[From [url=https://nlbproject.com/hub/game?name=am_i_a_monster_vn]official website[/url]]
translation:
你变成了狼人！但那副野兽般的外表，远不如体内正在成长的野兽危险。你是怪物，还是人类？你必须找到答案。

（来源：[url=https://nlbproject.com/hub/game?name=am_i_a_monster_vn]官方网站[/url]）
